style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent dark banquet Chinese crab cuisine e-commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of ink black background #111111, warm paper white #FDFBF7, deep navy woven cloth #22304E and one Chinese red accent #C8161D with charcoal text #2B2B2B; warm tone throughout; single warm 3500K directional key light from the upper left with deep natural falloff, deep controlled shadows, moist sheen and controlled highlights on the shell and soft contact shadows, never flat shadowless fill and never plastic-looking; modern bold geometric sans-serif headline type, no brush calligraphy and no custom lettering; consistent circular red badge labels and simple thin-line icons in the single red accent; surfaces limited to matte black slate #1A1A1A, deep navy woven cloth #22304E, natural bamboo steamer weave #C89B5E, white porcelain #F7F5F0 and small dark dipping dish #141414; product always presented whole and rope-tied at a stable slight 3/4 hero angle and stable scale with garnish and condiments kept at the edges; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random bright backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting direction, no mismatched icon styles, no plastic-looking food texture, no rope color or tying change.
